description: This Dart source file defines the NotesDao class, which manages database operations for notes, including CRUD operations, synchronization, and data queries within a note-taking app. It interacts with the database, provides streams for real-time updates, and handles note synchronization status.

classes.name: NotesDao
classes.description: A data access object class providing methods to query, update, and synchronize note data within the database.

methods.name: watchNotes
methods.description: Streams a list of notes matching a query, updating in real-time with database changes.

methods.name: watchNoteById
methods.description: Streams a single note identified by its ID, updating with any changes from the database.

methods.name: getNoteById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by its ID from the database.

methods.name: upsertLocal
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a note in the database locally and notifies change.

methods.name: markDeleted
methods.description: Marks a note as deleted and updates its synchronization status.

methods.name: setSyncStatus
methods.description: Sets synchronization status for a list of notes, optionally updating last synced timestamp.

methods.name: getNotesForPush
methods.description: Retrieves notes that need to be pushed to remote server based on sync status.

methods.name: getLastSyncAtMillis
methods.description: Gets the last synchronization timestamp in milliseconds.

methods.name: reconcileRemoteNotes
methods.description: Applies remote notes to local database based on a conflict resolution strategy.

methods.name: purgeSyncedTombstones
methods.description: Removes soft-deleted notes that are synchronized and old.

methods.name: _queryNotes
methods.description: Internal method to query notes by a search string with proper escaping.

methods.name: _escapeLike
methods.description: Escapes special characters in search query for SQL LIKE clause.

methods.name: _mapRow
methods.description: Maps a database row to a Note object.

methods.name: _toRow
methods.description: Converts a Note object into a map suitable for database insertion.
